rules.rationale: This commit is an Android 13 upstream synchronization containing generated Vulkan headers, CTS lists and generated LLVM tables rather than a BlueStacks product delta. Android 16 carries a substantially newer 25Q4 SwiftShader snapshot, including the Vulkan CTS 1.4 generation. Reapplying the A13 snapshot would downgrade generated interfaces and compiler tables as a single inconsistent block.
rules.necessity: Not necessary; Android 16 must retain its release-matched SwiftShader revision.
rules.performance: Avoids replacing newer compiler and rasterizer code with older generated LLVM data, which could regress Vulkan correctness and performance.
rules.security: Keeping the release-pinned upstream version preserves later validation and compiler fixes; generated headers must match their implementation revision.
validation_evidence: A13 HEAD is based on the Android 13 r49 synchronization; AOSP16 and Android-16 are corresponding 25Q4 snapshots with matching current file counts and layout.

rules.rationale: A13 temporarily deleted pipeline.txt and vk-master-NOT_SUPPORTED.txt only to restore both in the immediately later LFS commit. The deletion is not the authoritative A13 final state.
rules.necessity: Not necessary because reproducing an intermediate deletion would contradict the final A13 repository state.
rules.performance: Repository-storage-only transition with no guest runtime effect.
rules.security: No runtime security effect; preserving final test data avoids silently reducing conformance coverage.
validation_evidence: A13 history shows 9c8b7237 deleting both files and 9545e8ab restoring both as LFS objects.

rules.rationale: The final A13 intent is to keep oversized regression lists as LFS data. Android 16 retains LFS attributes and an LFS object for the current vk-master-NOT_SUPPORTED.txt. The old pipeline.txt no longer exists in the newer test-list layout and must not be restored from a different SwiftShader revision.
rules.necessity: Necessary only as repository storage metadata for current large test lists, not as a request to preserve obsolete A13 file names.
rules.performance: Reduces Git clone/object pressure for large generated lists; no guest runtime cost.
rules.security: LFS object availability must be checked before conformance builds so pointer text is not mistaken for a populated test list.
validation_evidence: Android-16 .gitattributes marks current Vulkan master lists for LFS and git lfs ls-files reports vk-master-NOT_SUPPORTED.txt; AOSP16 has the same current layout.

rules.rationale: A13 removed the third_party/llvm-project gitlink. Neither AOSP16 nor Android-16 tracks that submodule in the final SwiftShader repository, so the desired absence is preserved without a target-only commit.
rules.necessity: Required to avoid an unused nested repository and ambiguous LLVM source selection.
rules.performance: Reduces checkout size and submodule initialization work; no runtime impact.
rules.security: Removes an independently pinned code source that could drift from the SwiftShader release revision.
validation_evidence: git ls-files -s third_party/llvm-project returns no entry in A13 final, AOSP16 or Android-16.
